source_tasks: Port PRD selection and lifecycle directory resolution.
Port frontmatter parsing/defaults and overwrite warnings.
Port transition table and compound `phase-complete` command.
Port resume mapping and plan-size policy.
Port reset and completed-PRD summary derivation.
Port defer ledger with idempotent operation IDs.
Port stall/park filesystem saga and every existing failpoint.
Generate workflow command documentation from the parser.
